description: pdfLaTeX thesis with large NASA figures and 7 un-externalized TikZ pictures. One pdflatex pass, no bibliography.
limiter: Writing the output PDF. An unreported warm run used resource rusage: the original wrote 57840 blocks (about 29.6 MB) with 0.068 s of system time; the fixed zip wrote 6592 blocks (about 3.4 MB) with 0.008 s of system time. Draft mode, which does not write a PDF, took 0.313 s and 0.318 s, so typesetting and TikZ work did not change.
protocol: Sides were alternated (original, then fixed) with no shell-escape, in one persistent tree per side. Run 1 is a cold compile. Runs 2 to 6 are warm recompiles; the median and range are of those five. Separately, a fresh extract of the fixed zip was compiled with -shell-escape once to fill tikz-cache (1527.4 ms), then five more times; the 197.1 ms median is of those five.
